I am 78 years old and this small maize plot feeds my household, so I must tend it carefully even though my strength is not what it used to be. I will apply a small amount of urea and DAP that I managed to obtain through the voucher program, but only a modest amount because money is tight and this plot is just for family food. I will also mix in cow manure from my animals, and I will plant seed I saved from last season since it has always grown well here. My children and grandchildren will help with all the hoeing, planting, weeding, and harvesting by hand, so I do not need to hire any outside workers.
